title: Aphorism § 195
text:
§ 195



 In order to effect a radical cure in such cases, which are by no
          means rare, after the acute state has pretty well subsided, an appropriate antipsoric
          treatment (as is taught in my work on Chronic Diseases) must then be directed against the
          symptoms that still remain and the morbid state of health to which the patient was
          previously subject. In chronic local maladies that are not obviously venereal, the
          antipsoric internal treatment is, moreover, alone requisite.
